# mtncloud_environments (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud environments data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_environments" "tf_environments" {
  sort_ascending = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `sort_ascending` (Boolean) Whether to sort the IDs in ascending order

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ids` (List of Number) The IDs of the environments that match the filters.
